data.narrative:
9 Mothers is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Russell Smith, Roman Khomenko, and Bogdan Pyzh. The company has raised $4.5M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 4 same-sector peers at Seed and Series A stages, supplemented by a broader set of 10 public and private Defense & Security companies including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression methodology uses the $4.5M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying a valuation of $11M. Peer-Median analysis across the 4 comparable companies yields a median valuation of $700M, with a range spanning $125M (NODA AI, Series A) to $4.0B (Stark Defence, Series A). The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneous funding patterns and commercialization timelines within the sector.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $10M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $356M. The 80x spread between methods reflects fundamental uncertainty around 9 Mothers' relative positioning within a sector where peer valuations span two orders of magnitude. Key uncertainties include product maturity, customer pipeline, and defensibility relative to well-capitalized incumbents. Stage-progression serves as a floor given capital deployed; peer-median introduces ceiling risk absent differentiation evidence.
